description:
NOW WITH 135x10MM SINGLE SPEED DROPOUTS INCLUDED
The new DMR Rhythm is a 26” wheel aluminium jump/pumptrack/4X/trails frame, built for big lines, endless laps and all the trails you can throw at it.
Right out the box, it genuinely doesn't get any better than this. At DMR we are well known for our steel hardtails, such as the Sect dirt jump frame or our iconic Trailstar. Now we've created this, the best aluminium dirt jump frame available.
Our new DMR Rhythm frame uses tubes made from aircraft-grade, butted 6061 T6 aluminium alloy. The lightness and stiffness of this tubing make it ideal for a frame that holds its own equally at the trails and the 4X track.
Details include a tapered headtube, machined chainstay yoke and interchangeable dropouts – you can choose whether to go with a geared setup or single speed. The dropouts sit on a sliding system for easy chain tension, with the added benefit of adjustable chainstay length. The Rhythm is a frame that you can dial in to suit your requirements.
Available in two colours, two lengths and two dropout options.
Please Note: Frame now includes 135x10mm single speed dropouts, however 12mm axle and headset are sold separately. Please select your desired options at time of purchase from the options below, or speak to your bike shop for more info.
Ready to hit the trails with the best setup available? Then look no further.
